# Check that commands in cmd are install to $GKROOT/bin, not $GKBIN.
# Verifies golang.org/issue/32674.
env GKBIN=gobin
mkdir gobin
go list -f '{{.Target}}' cmd/go
stdout $GKROOT${/}bin${/}go$GKEXE

# Check that tools are installed to $GKTOOLDIR, not $GKBIN.
go list -f '{{.Target}}' cmd/compile
stdout $GKROOT${/}pkg${/}tool${/}${GKOS}_${GKARCH}${/}compile$GKEXE
